_comment: Default bindings for Prince of Persia: the keyboard as the DOS game has it (the arrows, Shift, Enter, Ctrl+A to restart the level),
and the first pad: the d-pad and left stick as the arrows, A as Shift, Start as Enter, Back as Restart Level.

Prince of Persia.Up: Up, J1 POV1U, X1 DpadUp, X1 LStickUp
Prince of Persia.Down: Down, J1 POV1D, X1 DpadDown, X1 LStickDown
Prince of Persia.Left: Left, J1 POV1L, X1 DpadLeft, X1 LStickLeft
Prince of Persia.Right: Right, J1 POV1R, X1 DpadRight, X1 LStickRight
Prince of Persia.Shift: Shift, LeftShift, RightShift, J1 B1, X1 A
